detachment · 7 Piaget 4 · 8 Erikson 8 · 9 GAS 3 · 10 appraisal/frame · 11 coping twins ·
12 crisis 5 · 13 defences 8 · 14 rainbow 5 · 15 gradient · 16 genogram · 17 negotiate ·
18 HBM 6 · 19 stages 6 · 20 efficacy · 21 PACE/OARS · 22 DARN · 23 SMART · 24 screen +
COUNTDOWN: 6 wks — map objectives + weak topics; 4 wks — timed past Qs + canvas answers;
2 wks — cards (theorists, stages, lists, 25 points); 1 wk — mock + role-play + sleep;
eve — pack + rest; DAY — read twice, canvas-structure, TAG theories, attempt ALL.
FORMULA: BPS → stage → stress → system → move → mind. Interviews: STAR from menu ("our
defaulters halved..."); "non-compliant?" = HBM/stage aloud; "why behavioural?" = one story
PORTFOLIO CROWN: genograms + screens log + OARS notes + reflections + CPD + menu results.
PLEDGE: "I will BPS every patient, stage every change, respect every defence, negotiate
every belief, evoke every reason, screen every mind — whole persons, wholly nursed."
TAG RULE: name the theorist or lose the mark — Engel! Erikson! Selye! Freud! Bandura!
MANTRA: "BPS it, stage it, stress it, system it, move it, mind it."
